m1.typescript: m1 a finding is recorded once per area and fact in first seen order

e1.typescript: e1 the scratchpad groups findings under their area

e2.typescript: e2 the manifest lists every agent with its state file and status and refuses bad input

e3.typescript: e3 a finished agent with its state file is reused and not run again

e4.typescript: e4 a running or failed agent with a state file is resumed from it

e5.typescript: e5 an agent whose state file is missing is restarted from scratch

e6.typescript: e6 the resume prompt carries the task and the state lines and nothing else

e7.typescript: e7 the compact command names what to keep

wrong-duplicate-findings.defect: records the same fact twice for one area

wrong-ungrouped-scratchpad.defect: repeats an area heading for every finding

wrong-manifest-unsorted.defect: lists the agents in the order they were given

wrong-manifest-unvalidated.defect: accepts a status the manifest does not know

wrong-rerun-done.defect: resumes an agent that already finished

wrong-restart-running.defect: restarts an agent that has a state file to resume from

wrong-ignore-missing-file.defect: trusts the manifest without checking that the state file exists

wrong-no-continue-line.defect: leaves the instruction to continue out of the prompt

wrong-compact-without-focus.defect: compacts without telling the command what to keep

wrong-reuse-needs-company.defect: reuses a finished agent only when the manifest lists more than one agent
